gen-dafont-nasalization-sora: Friendly, floating, a little retro. Nasalization is happiest splashed large with its big lowercase and calipers-open c, while Sora stays crisp and geometric in the sans text below.
gen-dafont-nasalization-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk brings hollow, breathing counters and a ribbon-like line to the text. Nasalization sits above it with short ascenders and widely spaced letters, and the two trade roundness for a tidy, techy rhythm.
gen-dafont-neon-fs-amulya: Every stroke of Neon is drawn at a single gauge, with tall stamped-metal lowercase and generous gaps between letters. Amulya softens it with modern, open curves.
gen-dafont-neon-fs-chillax: Glowing, tall and vividly spaced. Chillax loosens things up beneath Neon, its sans curves lifting off before the loop closes, which gives the stiff uniform lines above a relaxed counterpoint.
gen-dafont-neon-fs-plein: Plein is the reliable half here, with a clear channel leading into each round letter. Plein also gives Neon, with its tubelike strokes that never taper, a grounded plain sans partner, and that tension is the pair's best trait.
gen-dafont-neon-fs-roundo: Neon glows with tall, stamped-metal lowercase and strokes that never taper or thin. Roundo steps in as a plain sans with matching arch and stem on its n, and Neon earns its keep when it is big and brief.
gen-dafont-neon-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans reads wide open and approachable, with generous gaps where curves meet stems. And Neon's tall, glowing lowercase against that moderate-height text is the real draw of this pair.
gen-dafont-neon-fs-synonym: Neon's strokes never change thickness, giving tall stamped-metal letters a vivid glow. Synonym follows as a plain sans with generous curve openings, so extended reading feels clean and dependable.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-almendra: Neon draws every letter as one glowing, constant line. It earns its keep big and brief, while Almendra's deep-bellied lowercase adds a dignified, bookish serif voice beneath it.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-bree-serif: Bree Serif reads literary and refined, its outsized lowercase giving the serif text real presence. And Neon's technical-pen steadiness and tall glowing letters sit above it, so the page feels both precise and warm.
